text: Cedar laboratory transfer policy P1. Effective 4 November 2026. All entities and events are synthetic. P1: For transfer T7 on 4 November 2026, count the three ledger charges A, B and C once each, in whole credits. No tax, discount or currency conversion applies. A revised ledger explicitly supersedes the prior ledger for this transfer. P2: Each individual charge must be at most 50 credits. A charge above 50 breaches the individual-charge cap; aggregate totals do not replace this test. P3: T7 receipt is timely if the physical receipt timestamp is no later than 16:30 local time on 4 November 2026. No grace period applies. Dispatch time is irrelevant. P4: T7 release eligibility requires both quality approval and security approval by 17:00 local time. Quality approval alone is insufficient. A missing security-status field is not a statement that no approval event occurred. P5: This package contains no definition or grading scale for the adjective exemplary. The package is complete only for charges A, B and C; it is not a complete approval-event history.
